replaces.idea: A stout steel safe-deposit drawer on a low base with four tabbed metal index plates protruding from the top, representing the CPU register snapshot saved on SMI entry.
A wall-mounted spring-loaded deadbolt latch with a bright angled release lever, representing the RSM instruction that unlatches SMRAM and returns to normal execution.
A tall riveted steel vault bulkhead bolted to the floor, marking the TSEG protected memory boundary carved out at the top of memory.

new.name: Save-State Drawer
new.concept: SMRAM Save State Map (CPU register dump on SMI entry)
new.depicts: A heavy steel safe-deposit drawer sitting on a low base with a front pull handle and four tabbed metal index plates protruding from the top.
new.focal: The four stacked tabbed index plates

new.name: RSM Latch
new.concept: RSM (Resume from System Management Mode) instruction
new.depicts: A compact wall-mounted spring-loaded deadbolt latch on a rectangular backplate with a bright angled release lever.

new.name: TSEG Bulkhead
new.concept: TSEG (Top of Memory Segment) protected SMRAM region
new.depicts: A tall riveted steel vault bulkhead bolted to the floor with a thick top flange and a recessed armored seam.
new.focal: The vertical row of heavy rivets along the seam

new.name: SMBASE Compass
new.concept: SMBASE register (relocatable base address of SMRAM)
new.depicts: A small steel surveyor's transit dial mounted on a stubby tripod base with a single bright pointer needle.
new.focal: The bright pointer needle on the dial

new.name: SMI# Klaxon
new.concept: SMI# (System Management Interrupt) non-maskable hardware trigger
new.depicts: A wall-mounted industrial alarm bell with a round dome, a bottom striker hammer, and a bright indicator stud.
new.focal: The striker hammer poised beneath the dome

new.name: D_OPEN Keyway
new.concept: D_OPEN bit (temporarily opens SMRAM to normal memory access)
new.depicts: A small wall-mounted key-switch escutcheon with a turned key protruding from the vertical slot.
new.focal: The turned key protruding from the slot

new.name: SMI Dispatch Desk
new.concept: SMM Interrupt Handler (privileged code at SMBASE + 0x8000)
new.depicts: A sturdy steel-framed dispatch console standing on four legs with a tilted switchboard and a single glowing lamp.
new.focal: The glowing dispatch lamp on the tilted console
